82871: Onoda Sakamichi is the main protagonist of the Yowamushi Pedal series who starts off as a new first-year student in Souhoku High School. He is a member of the Souhoku High Bicycle Club and specializes in climbing. Onoda is also an anime otaku, his favorite anime being Love Hime.
82873: Imaizumi is a high school freshman and a member of the Sohoku High Bicycle Club. He is an all-rounder and a logical thinker, also adored by many girls due to his good looks. His dream is to become the fastest cyclist in the world.
82875: As a sprinter, he has a competitive nature, and easily gets upset or disappointed when he is beaten in a race. He considered Imaizumi his rival, and therefore gets particularly riled up when he thinks that Imaizumi is winning.
86595: Formerly the Captain and Ace of Souhoku High Bicycle Club during his high school days. Currently a first-year student at Yonan University, also joined its Bicycle Club.
86599: Makishima was and still is often seen as creepy due to his facial expressions, strange hair color, and irregular dancing style.
88723: Tadokoro is a loud, confident person with a personality as big as his stature. He is a proud sprinter and has no qualms about boasting when he wins. However, Tadokoro also has a softer side, exemplified by how much he cares about Teshima and Aoyagi.
88724: He is now a third year student at Souhoku High School, the former ace, Shingo Kinjou, appointed him as the ace of the cycling club, and he takes his role very seriously. He is very smart and uses strategies to win races along with his close friend Aoyagi.
88725: He is now a third-year student at Souhoku High School and has been named vice-captain. He is usually silent and only speaks when necessary. Even if he rarely speaks, he thinks a lot and cares a great deal about his friends and teammates.
88726: Midousuji has a sadistic and eccentric personality; he'll do anything to win including constantly causing others emotional distress. He appears to particularly enjoy harassing Imaizumi, but anyone he races against becomes a target of his mind games.
88732: Arakita has a bad mouth and is a competitive cyclist. He adds the suffix "-chan" onto the names or nicknames of certain people (Fukutomi, Onoda, Manami), a habit that doesn't seem to match his otherwise gruff behavior.
88734: Toudou has a very cheerful, childish, boastful, and loud personality. He constantly references his fanclub and his own beauty, a habit which often irritates others, resulting in them telling him to shut up or dismissing his claims.
88737: As he grew older, his deepening passion for cycling resulted in his current easygoing personality; he is often late to or napping in class because he feels dull and confined indoors.
88738: Shinkai generally has a very laid-back and placid personality. He shown to be very caring; when he ran over a rabbit with his bike, he deeply regretted his actions decided to raise the rabbit's baby, naming it Usakichi.
88742: He is now a third year student at Hakone Academy, the former ace, Juichi Fukutomi, appointed him as the ace of the cycling club, and he takes his role very seriously.
88745: Ishigaki is kind and friendly, as exhibited by his relationships with his teammates and interactions with other characters.
88746: As his stoic face suggests, Fukutomi has a very serious personality. He puts a lot of effort into living up to the title of "kings" of Hakogaku. While his methods may seem harsh, it is clear that Fukutomi has incredible confidence in his teammates.
121329: He is a third-year student at Hakone Academy and the vice-captain of the Hakone Academy bicycle club during the second year Prior to joining the Hakone Cycling Club, Kuroda was somewhat arrogant and conceited because of his athleticism and skills in nearly every sport.
174648: She is the school's bicycle club manager. Though she doesn't race, she is very knowledgeable about bicycles because her brother, who happens to be a former bicycle club member, owns a bike shop, and she helps out repairing and assembling bicycles.
218953: The titular character in the anime 'Love Hime' that Onoda loves to watch.
251913: Sugimoto is a member of the Sohoku High Bicycle Club. He is best known for constantly referring to himself as "an experienced cyclist."
313463: Sakamichi's mother is the mother of the protagonist, Sakamichi. She supports her son's cycling without really knowing what it's all about.
